# Upstream license files

Copied byte for byte from the upstream sources below because the installed npm packages do not
include them. `scripts/third-party-notices.mjs` reads these files; do not edit them by hand.

| File | Source | Retrieved |
|---|---|---|
| `lightweight-charts-5.2.1-NOTICE` | https://raw.githubusercontent.com/tradingview/lightweight-charts/v5.2.1/NOTICE (the npm package has no NOTICE file) | 2026-11-08 |
| `fancy-canvas-2.1.0-LICENSE` | https://raw.githubusercontent.com/tradingview/fancy-canvas/2.1.0/LICENSE (the npm package declares `"license": "MIT"` but ships no license file) | 2026-11-08 |
| `geist-OFL.txt` | https://raw.githubusercontent.com/google/fonts/main/ofl/geist/OFL.txt (identical to `ofl/geistmono/OFL.txt`); `next/font/google` downloads Geist and Geist Mono from Google Fonts at build time and serves them from this app | 2026-11-08 |

The NOTICE file's "(с)" uses U+0441 (Cyrillic small letter es), reproduced as published.
